name: Cryptographic Workload Identity & SPIFFE SVID
description: Every autonomous enterprise agent must possess a unique, verifiable SPIFFE ID with X.509 SVID or JWT token, bound to its workload namespace.
remediationGuide: Configure SPIRE Workload API sidecar to mint SVIDs dynamically to agent containers.

name: Prompt & Model Provenance Integrity Attestation
description: Foundation model digest and system prompt manifest must be hashed (SHA-256) and signed at container deployment time to detect tampered instructions.
remediationGuide: Enforce CI/CD signature step using Cosign/Sigstore before spinning up agent runtimes.

name: Cryptographic Delegation Chain & Intent Ceiling
description: Downstream worker and sub-agents must carry a cryptographically signed delegation chain originating from an authorized human employee or certified orchestrator.
targetThreshold: Valid signature chain with max risk ceiling
remediationGuide: Mandate parent orchestrator signs task delegation tokens with strict risk ceiling.

name: Ephemeral Session Tokens (TTL <= 30 mins)
description: Agents must not hold persistent long-lived API tokens. Session tokens must have strict TTL <= 30 minutes with single-flight nonces.
remediationGuide: Configure AegisZero token minter to enforce 1800s maximum lifetime.

name: Multidimensional Real-Time Scoring (6 Dimensions)
description: Every proposed tool execution must be evaluated across all 6 risk dimensions (Intent Drift, Tool Criticality, Blast Radius, Context Sensitivity, Trajectory Anomaly, Environment Volatility).
remediationGuide: Integrate the AegisZero composite scoring equation inside the PEP interceptor.

name: Semantic Intent Drift Attestation Boundary
description: Mathematical or LLM-based vector cosine distance between the original approved human mission and the tool invocation payload must be computed.
remediationGuide: Enable the server-side Gemini Intent Attestation API or local embedding attestation engine.

name: Dynamic Risk Policy Banding (4 Thresholds)
description: Policy engine must enforce 4 discrete response tiers: ALLOW (<30), STEP_UP/ATTENUATE (30-59), HITL (60-79), QUARANTINE (>=80).
remediationGuide: Verify OPA policy adaptive_authz.rego enforces all 4 action bands.

name: Strict Separation: Untrusted Reasoning vs Deterministic PEP

frameworkMappings.owaspLlm: LLM01: Prompt Injection, LLM02: Insecure Output

description: The agent reasoning loop (LLM) must never have direct network or database access. All actions pass through a deterministic proxy that holds credentials.
targetThreshold: Zero direct network egress from agent container
remediationGuide: Deploy the AegisZero PEP sidecar and restrict agent pod egress via Kubernetes NetworkPolicy.

name: Capability-Based Access Control (Macaroons / C-Tokens)
description: Tool access must be governed by attenuated cryptographic capability tokens with embedded caveats (resource URI, allowed verbs, max records, max dollar amount).
remediationGuide: Transition from role-based IAM to AegisZero C-Token caveat verification in PEP.

name: Strict Schema & Parameter Boundary Validation
description: Every tool argument must be strictly validated against formal JSON Schema specifications before invocation. Unexpected parameters must trigger rejection.
remediationGuide: Implement strict JSON Schema validator in PEP middleware pipeline.

name: Cumulative Blast Radius Accumulation Tracking
description: The PEP must track aggregate impact over time (e.g. cumulative financial sum, total customer records read across steps) rather than evaluating steps in isolation.
remediationGuide: Ensure Trajectory Monitor state store maintains sliding window session blast radius counters.

name: Autonomous Loop & Velocity Spike Detection
description: Detect recursive tool invocation cycles, denial-of-wallet loops, and abnormal step frequencies exceeding velocity thresholds.
targetThreshold: Max 5 consecutive identical tool cycles allowed
remediationGuide: Enable cyclic graph detection in TrajectoryEngine.

name: Forbidden Tool Transition Constraints

frameworkMappings.owaspLlm: LLM01: Prompt Injection, LLM06: Excessive Agency

description: Enforce state machine transition graph rules (e.g., Reading unverified external internet content CANNOT be immediately followed by internal credential or financial transfer APIs).
remediationGuide: Define forbidden tool transition matrix in AegisZero policy rules.

name: Dual-Custody Human Approval for High-Impact Mutations
description: Actions exceeding enterprise thresholds (financial mutations > $50k, table drop, bulk PII export > 500 records) must block and require dual human signatures.
targetThreshold: Dual-custody gate active for critical operations
remediationGuide: Configure HITL approval service with multi-approver role requirements.

name: Dynamic Parameter Attenuation for Borderline Actions
description: Rather than simple binary rejection, the system must support dynamic capability attenuation (e.g., automatically clamping record limits, stripping PII flags, converting writes to dry-runs).
remediationGuide: Implement Rego-based parameter mutation in PEP response handler.

name: Instant Agent Quarantine Kill-Switch (MTTR < 100ms)
description: A single API call or policy violation at risk level CRITICAL must immediately revoke all ephemeral tokens and terminate the agent session across the fleet.
remediationGuide: Connect PEP to Redis/In-Memory token revocation cache with sub-millisecond propagation.

name: Tamper-Evident Cryptographic Audit Ledger
description: All tool calls, risk scoring breakdowns, PEP enforcement decisions, and human approvals must be logged into an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained audit trail.
remediationGuide: Enable hash-chained event streaming to enterprise SIEM/Splunk.
